title: Redeem a gift card inside the transaction

cases.says: a redemption the balance covers is answered 00 and the amount comes off the card
a redemption larger than the balance is answered 51 and the card keeps its balance
a redemption a later participant declines takes nothing, because the debit went through Open's connection and was rolled back
two redemptions at once can't both spend the same balance, because the check and the debit are one statement in prepare and the row stays locked until Close
a database failure while debiting becomes a 96 answer in prepare, not a transaction nobody answers

origin.section: 9.3 Write in `prepare`, So the Database Can Still Say No
